remarks:
Location, Location, Location! Welcome to this adorable, well-maintained ranch ideally situated right next door to a marina and canal with boat launch access, making it the perfect retreat for boating and lake enthusiasts. Even better, the property offers deeded water rights to Chautauqua Lake! Currently enjoyed as a summer home, this charming property could easily be enjoyed year-round and comes fully furnished, making it truly move-in ready.

Inside, the inviting open-concept great room seamlessly combines the kitchen and living areas, with plenty of space for gatherings with family and friends. Warm knotty pine walls give the home a classic lake-house feel, while the wood-burning stove creates a cozy place to gather on cooler evenings. Step outside to the concrete patio, perfect for relaxing, grilling or entertaining after a day on the lake. The home has been lovingly maintained and features several recent improvements, including a new roof, gutters, front door and storm door.

A garage provides additional storage for your vehicle, boating equipment and lake toys. With furnishings included, right down to the dishes, silverware and even paddleboat, this property offers a turnkey opportunity for a summer getaway, year-round home or potential short-term rental. With the marina and boat launch next door and Chautauqua Lake water rights, everything you need to start enjoying the lake lifestyle is already here. Bring your boat, unpack your bags and start enjoying lake life!
